content: Akanksha Bhatt reached out to check her health insurance policy (HP-4521) status and discovered it expired on September 30, 2026. Insurance agent Anita Sharma assisted her with the renewal process, explaining a minor premium increase to ₹12,500. After Akanksha requested a loyalty discount, Anita applied a 5% reduction, bringing the final premium to ₹11,875. Akanksha agreed to proceed, and Anita sent the renewal documentation via a link.

action_items: Process the policy renewal for HP-4521
Send renewal documents to the customer
